answer: The strongest lever is simple: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because spiral only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, cipher is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any horizon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
